info.title: Doorstar Production Service API
info.description: Contract for the live Doorstar Üzemi Tábla REST service. The Planning C# service is a separate, future contract.

post.description: Legacy board Task creation is fail-closed. Ad-hoc notes/drafts require a future non-production model; this endpoint cannot bypass immutable production-release lineage.

patch.description: An unbound task cannot be attached to a project or epic without immutable production-release lineage.

409.description: Issued-task association is immutable or legacy production issue is blocked

get.description: Lists read-only Flow Lab handoff snapshots bound to one Doorstar project. Import itself is a configured filesystem/CLI action, not an HTTP upload.

patch.description: Finalizes a REVIEW file handoff exactly once. VERIFIED re-evaluates the exact order/component binding, map fingerprint and independent reviewer principal.

post.description: Creates the four configured worksheet family epics and their step rows only from a current VERIFIED Flow Lab snapshot. It never creates production Tasks.

get.description: Returns the bounded, cursor-paginated read model of immutable board observations. Records cannot be updated or deleted.

patch.description: Narrow editable-row command. Flow Lab semantic changes append typed deviation evidence; the board-owned calendar anchor remains local. Generic worksheet replacement is rejected.

post.description: Adds a deliberate manual worksheet step inside a Flow Lab family and appends STEP_ADDED_BY_HAND evidence with null correlationKey.

201.description: Manual step and its immutable deviation record

200.description: Active, fingerprinted component-calculator adapter profiles. The explicit adapter executes no formulas and supplies no implicit defaults.
Latest revision summary for active production orders

get.description: Server-authoritative, read-only projection for one exact order revision, evaluated in one repeatable-read snapshot. A historical revision remains readable but can never be projected as current. Missing planning/work-package authority gives PRODUCTION_RELEASE the explicit NOT_AVAILABLE state.

Read-only latest-revision workflow projection evaluated in the same repeatable-read snapshot as its exact-revision readiness. Order, component and operation gates reuse exact-revision authority; planning, immutable work package, 6-stage runtime and handover stay CONTRACT_REQUIRED and never infer authority from legacy Tasks.

200.description: Authoritative and explicitly unavailable project workflow gates

409.description: Invalid transition, missing stage data, or stale DRAFT writer
Stale revision or already replaced document version

201.description: Exact document version linked to position

404.description: Project, revision, document or position not found

post.description: Rechecks the approval audit/hash and position-evidence gate before freezing exact document versions.

201.description: Manual or source-reviewed supplementary item recorded

200.description: Supplementary item updated while awaiting review

400.description: Invalid request, or a manual item would lose its required quantity, unit or reason

204.description: Manual supplementary item deleted while awaiting review

patch.description: Finalizes one SOURCE_REVIEW evidence row exactly once. The captured source values remain immutable.

200.description: Evidence finalized as RESOLVED or REJECTED
Supplementary item finalized as verified or rejected
Immutable component and cutting snapshots for the order revision

400.description: Revision path value is not a positive integer

post.description: Materializes explicitly supplied, reviewed adapter output for one approved latest order revision. No formula is executed and no missing value is defaulted. The order revision plus calculator profile is the idempotency scope. Every source-derived item on the revision is rechecked even when omitted from the adapter payload.

200.description: The identical profile output already exists and was replayed idempotently (`created` is false)

201.description: A new immutable snapshot was created in REVIEW state (`created` is true)

400.description: Request validation failed or a material/finish catalog key is invalid

403.description: technical_preparation, order_approver or production_planner role required

patch.description: Finalizes a REVIEW snapshot exactly once as VERIFIED or REJECTED. Verification rechecks that the source order is still approved, latest, source-ready and content-hash intact.

200.description: Snapshot finalized as VERIFIED or REJECTED

404.description: Project, revision or snapshot not found

get.description: Returns exact-revision operation-plan snapshots plus the current server-authoritative create readiness and structured blockers.

404.description: Project or exact order revision not found

post.description: Idempotently materializes explicit, evidence-resolved operations for one exact current VERIFIED component snapshot. No standard, resource, duration, dependency or review result is inferred. PlanningProposal and IssuedWorkPackage are outside this authority.

404.description: Project or exact order revision not found

409.description: Exact lineage, active authority, evidence, dependency or idempotency conflict

patch.description: Finalizes REVIEW exactly once as VERIFIED or REJECTED with a mandatory reason, output-hash concurrency token and creator/reviewer principal separation. VERIFIED rechecks every current authority and hash; REJECTED remains the fail-safe exit.

404.description: Project, revision or operation-plan snapshot not found

409.description: Final state, concurrency, separation-of-duties or revalidation conflict

200.description: Feedback items for the order revision

404.description: Project, revision or feedback not found

post.description: Records an immutable source candidate in UNVERIFIED or REVIEW state. Final states are rejected at validation and can only be reached by the one-way review command.

201.description: Field-level source evidence recorded without changing the position

404.description: Project, revision or position not found

patch.description: Finalizes one row exactly once as RESOLVED or REJECTED with mandatory reason, reviewer role, declared principal and reviewedAt. It never applies the normalized candidate to the position.

200.description: Evidence finalized without changing the position

404.description: Project, revision, position or evidence not found

201.description: Standalone panel/front candidate and evidence recorded

patch.description: Finalizes one manufactured-item evidence row exactly once. Captured source values remain immutable.

200.description: Evidence finalized as RESOLVED or REJECTED

patch.description: Finalizes a candidate exactly once. VERIFIED requires at least one evidence row and complete audited RESOLVED decisions for every row.

200.description: Candidate finalized as verified or rejected

201.description: Revision frozen for review with hash schema v3
Revision approved with versioned content hash

409.description: Stale revision or invalid position ownership

201.description: New project and Sales draft created
Draft revision created; the previous approved revision is atomically marked SUPERSEDED

409.description: A DRAFT/REVIEW revision already exists, or the prior approval audit is missing

200.description: Backend-owned, work-number grouped import review projection
Source locators, payloads and review facts for one import work number

409.description: Test-schema guard, duplicate run, or invalid import state

200.description: Selected READY candidates applied idempotently to the imported test DRAFT

409.description: Test-schema, fingerprint, revision, candidate state or payload conflict

200.description: Queryable import candidates and deadline observations

201.description: Candidate evidence stored in test schema
Deadline observation stored without changing the order header

409.description: Test schema or revision provenance conflict

post.description: Returns 200 only for an already-issued no-op. Any new legacy Task materialization is fail-closed.
Returns 200 for a no-op when every active step is already issued. Missing dates retain precedence; any new legacy Task materialization is fail-closed.

200.description: Versioned free-form sheet JSON or null

Role.name: X-Role
Role.description: Temporary login-less role hint. `vezeto` is required by manager-only mutations; this is not authentication.

ReadModelRole.name: X-Role
ReadModelRole.description: Temporary read hint only. Responses and authority owners always use canonical Doorstar roles; legacy `vezeto`/`allomas` are mapped to administrator/shop_floor. Omission is read-only reader.

Principal.name: X-Principal
Principal.description: Declared reviewer identifier persisted in the audit. Until authenticated identity lands, omission is stored explicitly as `legacy-role:<X-Role>`; this header is not authentication.

Station.name: X-Station
Station.description: Temporary station-operator hint; evaluated only for task updates.

Unauthorized.description: A required explicit Flow Lab role or principal header is missing

LegacyProductionIssueConflict.description: Legacy Task creation is disabled until exact immutable production-release lineage exists

CannotDeleteColumn.description: First/last or invalid workflow column cannot be deleted

ProjectKeyConflict.description: Active or archived project already uses the key

MissingPlanDates.description: No partial session was issued because at least one source step lacks a planned date

IssueSessionConflict.description: A planned date is missing or immutable production-release lineage is unavailable

IssueStepConflict.description: A planned date/predecessor is missing or immutable production-release lineage is unavailable

RevokeStepConflict.description: Completed steps and steps with an issued successor cannot be revoked

SupplementaryReviewNotFound.description: The scoped order revision, supplementary item or evidence does not exist

SupplementaryReviewConflict.description: The revision, aggregate or evidence decision is immutable, or the source-evidence gate is not satisfied

ManufacturedReviewNotFound.description: The scoped order revision, manufactured item or evidence does not exist

ManufacturedReviewConflict.description: The revision, source relation, aggregate or evidence decision conflicts with the manufactured-item evidence gate

ComponentSnapshotCreateConflict.description: The revision is not approved/latest/source-ready/unchanged, the expected hash or active profile differs, a referenced source is foreign/unverified, or the profile already has different output

ComponentSnapshotReviewConflict.description: The review is final, the snapshot changed, or an approved source-order invariant no longer holds

PositionEvidenceConflict.description: The revision changed/froze, the document is foreign, or the one-way evidence decision is already final

OrderRevisionGateConflict.description: The order state, approval hash, or position-evidence readiness gate is not satisfied

RevisionWriteConflict.description: A DRAFT writer observed a frozen/stale revision

planDate.description: Board-owned calendar anchor; intentionally excluded from the Flow Lab deviation feed.
Board-owned calendar anchor; intentionally excluded from the Flow Lab deviation feed.

ReadinessGateKey.description: Response order is SURVEY, POSITION_EVIDENCE, DOCUMENTS, MANUFACTURED_ITEMS, SUPPLEMENTARY_ITEMS, ORDER_REVIEW, COMPONENT_SNAPSHOT, OPERATION_PLAN, PRODUCTION_RELEASE.

ComponentRequirementInput.description: One explicit adapter-output line. CUT_PART requires material plus both finished and cutting dimensions; no value is derived or defaulted.

ComponentSnapshotCreate.description: Explicit, human-reviewed calculator-adapter output. sourceComponentKey values must be unique within the request. Idempotency is scoped to the approved order revision and calculator profile version.

OperationCandidateInput.description: Explicit plan-only operation. Actual measurements, execution actors, inspection results and nonconformance decisions are forbidden from this model.

ManufacturedItemEvidenceInput.description: Captured source evidence. Final review states and reviewer resolution cannot be supplied during creation.

SourceEvidenceReviewerRole.description: Normative reviewer roles plus temporary login-less administrator/leader compatibility identities.

OrderSupplementaryItemEvidenceInput.description: Captured source evidence. Final review states cannot be supplied during creation.

OrderSupplementaryItemUpdate.description: Partial update while the item awaits review. MANUAL items must retain a non-null quantity, unit and manualReason after merging the patch.

contentHashSchemaVersion.description: 1=legacy; 2=source-derived evidence audit; 3=position evidence plus exact document-position lineage.

ProjectSheetData.description: Current legacy free-form JSON. A version discriminator and validation are deferred to DSCONV-04/05.
